title: Post analysis extraction v1
description: Text-grounded semantic extraction for one Telegram post revision.

annotations.description: All semantic annotations extracted from the supplied post text.

entities.description: Monitoring-relevant actors explicitly mentioned in the text.

stances.description: Observed attributed evaluations of extracted entities.

claims.description: Atomic propositions asserted, reported, quoted, denied, or questioned.

rhetorical_features.description: Observable rhetorical devices from the approved taxonomy.

span.description: A half-open Unicode character range in the supplied post text.

end.description: Zero-based exclusive character offset; must be greater than start.

perspective.description: The voice expressing a stance, claim, or rhetorical feature.

source_kind.description: Whether the source is the channel, an extracted entity, an unnamed source, or unknown.

source_entity_id.description: Local speaking-entity ID; null unless source_kind is named_entity.

entity.description: One text mention of a monitoring-relevant actor; its ID is local to this response.

id.description: Response-local entity reference, such as e1; not a registry ID.

mention_span.description: Exact span occupied by this entity mention.

surface_form.description: Exact text at mention_span, copied without normalization.

entity_type.description: Text-supported actor category; use the most specific available category.

subject_role.description: Primary when centrally discussed or evaluated; secondary when contextual.

stance.description: An attributed evaluative position toward one extracted entity.

entity_id.description: Local ID of the entity receiving the evaluation.

perspective.description: Voice responsible for the evaluation, not necessarily the channel.

value.description: Observed evaluation; use insufficient_context when no position is established.

claim.description: One atomic proposition grounded in the text.

id.description: Response-local claim reference, such as c1.

normalized_text.description: Concise Ukrainian restatement preserving facts, negation, attribution, and uncertainty.

entity_ids.description: Local IDs of extracted entities participating in the proposition.

evidence_spans.description: Exact spans expressing or supporting this claim.

attribution.description: Voice that asserts, reports, denies, or asks the claim.

presentation.description: How the post presents the claim.

epistemic_status.description: How strongly the claim is presented as true.

rhetorical_feature.description: One observable rhetorical device, separate from stance and claims.

evidence_span.description: Exact span containing the rhetorical device.

target_entity_id.description: Local ID of the targeted entity, when identifiable.

target_claim_id.description: Local ID of the targeted claim, when identifiable.
